# Reshape the data to have one row per country and year
education_expenditure_data_melted = education_expenditure_data.melt(id_vars=['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Series Name', 'Series Code'], var_name='Year', value_name='Education_Expenditure')
gdp_data_melted = gdp_data.melt(id_vars=['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Series Name', 'Series Code'], var_name='Year', value_name='GDP')

# Merge the two datasets on 'Country Group', 'Country Code', and 'Year'
merged_data = pd.merge(education_expenditure_data_melted, gdp_data_melted, on=['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Year'])

# Display the first few rows of the merged dataset
merged_data.head()

# Perform a linear regression analysis for each country group
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Separate the data by country group
sub_saharan_data = merged_data_clean[merged_data_clean['Country Group'] == 'Sub-Saharan Africa']
lower_middle_income_data = merged_data_clean[merged_data_clean['Country Group'] == 'Lower middle income']

# Perform regression for Sub-Saharan Africa
X_sub_saharan = sm.add_constant(sub_saharan_data['Education_Expenditure'])
model_sub_saharan = sm.OLS(sub_saharan_data['GDP'], X_sub_saharan).fit()
print(model_sub_saharan.summary())

# Perform regression for Lower Middle Income countries
X_lower_middle_income = sm.add_constant(lower_middle_income_data['Education_Expenditure'])
model_lower_middle_income = sm.OLS(lower_middle_income_data['GDP'], X_lower_middle_income).fit()
print(model_lower_middle_income.summary())

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Perform regression for Sub-Saharan Africa
if not sub_saharan_data.empty:
    X_sub_saharan = sub_saharan_data[['Education_Expenditure']]
    y_sub_saharan = sub_saharan_data['GDP']
    model_sub_saharan = LinearRegression().fit(X_sub_saharan, y_sub_saharan)
    coefficient_sub_saharan = model_sub_saharan.coef_[0]
    intercept_sub_saharan = model_sub_saharan.intercept_
    print(f"Sub-Saharan Africa: Coefficient = {coefficient_sub_saharan}, Intercept = {intercept_sub_saharan}")
else:
    print("No data for Sub-Saharan Africa.")

# Perform regression for Lower Middle Income countries
if not lower_middle_income_data.empty:
    X_lower_middle_income = lower_middle_income_data[['Education_Expenditure']]

    print(f"Lower Middle Income: Coefficient = {coefficient_lower_middle_income}, Intercept = {intercept_lower_middle_income}")
